style.backgroundSystem: draped rose-pink silk #F7E3E8 for benefit and variant shots, clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm greige and blush neutrals for info and scene shots
style.iconSystem: round deep-rose seal badges and thin-line pictogram tags only
style.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent romantic floral body-cleansing visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of silk pink #F7E3E8, deep rose accent #C94F72, warm white #FFFFFF and warm grey-brown text #4A3A3E; bright soft warm studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with round deep-rose seal badges; clean high-end body-wash photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright pump-bottle hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright pump-bottle hero angle; product scale and centering consistent across the set
style.surfaceSystem: soft silk drape, matte warm-stone counter and matte beige board
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with refined serif headline option
